specification_compliance: Touch-point question: every product path in the diff falls within the declared touch points. mostWatched.ts is the 'small module beside' watchedRangesStore. layout.ts is edited, which I read as within the 'beside layout.ts' entry. The unit-test directories are not listed (R1). hooks/useMediaControlsState.ts is listed but not touched, which is under-reach, not over-reach.

I1: spotsFromPieces merges runs of level 2 or 3 pieces that are contiguous (run.end === piece.start), cuts on level 1 and on gaps (no row), and sorts by strength desc, length desc, start asc. This matches.
I2: handleJump finds the remembered start in the current list, advances with wrap, falls back to index 0, returns before any state change if seek throws, and does not call play or pause.
I3: rememberedRef is cleared only by the registrationKey effect and lost on remount. Changes to duration, spots and availability do not touch it.

I4: jumpAvailable combines mc, nickname, duration>0 (duration is normalised to finite in useMediaControlsState), !interrupted (matching the presenters' seekable check), interactive and spots>0. The shortcut's `when` reads the published flag, and ShortcutsProvider.tsx:107 returns false (not consumed) when `when` is false. The label is gated on jumpAvailable synchronously.
I5: there is a 2 s label timer, restarted on each press, in a role=status aria-live=polite region stacked below the boost pill. reportSkip and resetTapSequence are called on every successful jump.
I6: the jump path calls only mc.seek and the in-memory store. No fetch and no storage.
I7: the pointer button comes after +10 when frameWidth >= 524, with title; the touch button comes before full screen; there is no compact button; COMPACT_MAX_WIDTH is unchanged.
I8: the ja/en strings at en.json/ja.json:573-574 and :1187 match the spec.
potential_unspecified_behavior: After an unavailable spell during which the 2 s label timer fired, the label stays hidden when availability returns. Within 2 s, the availability effect has already cleared mostWatched, so the label does not come back. This is consistent with 'a label on screen hides'.
Between a render that changes `spots` and the passive effect that resubscribes handleJump, a P press would use the previous spots list. The window is one commit and has no practical effect.
regression_risks: GestureOverlay moved the boost pill's absolute top-centre positioning onto a new wrapper. Existing GestureOverlay tests check only the testid and text, so a positioning regression of the boost pill alone would not be caught.
watchedRangesStore.dropEntryIfUnused now also waits for jumpListeners to be empty. An entry is kept alive while MediaControls is mounted, which matches skipListeners.
test_coverage: The order, wrap, spot-vanish, duration-change, file, nickname and remount cases (I1-I3) are covered in peakJump.order.test.tsx.
Profile, duration, ad break and level-2 emergence for availability, plus the label, live region, skip reveal and touch bottom-only (I4, I5), are covered in peakJump.controls.test.tsx.

P, Shift+P, macOS Ctrl+P, Cmd+P, Ctrl+P print, editing focus, non-consumption without a profile, and the compact and narrow pointer layouts are covered in peakJump.shortcuts.test.tsx. ShellVideoPlayer is covered in peakJump.shell.test.tsx.
Real-browser placement and clipping at 524/523/480 and the touch order are covered in the e2e specs.
Gaps: the interactive=false gate, P after a MediaControls unmount on the same file (R2), and the label below a simultaneous boost pill (R3).
